Results.ReviewText: The Spirit 2-burner grill is the best. It has plenty of grilling area, and since the side tables fold down, it takes up very little space when not in use. I downgraded from a larger Weber grill and am extremely pleased with this one. Plus, it has the typical quality of a Weber grill. I definitely recommend it.
Results.Title: Awesome compact grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love it, the right size and price for me, because I live alone. Easy to use.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, assembled easily in about 2 hours. Heats up quickly and cooks food nicely.
Results.Title: Spirit 2 burner grill

Results.ReviewText: The cooking is great but the tank must be hoisted up to a scale hanging from the side to measure the propane. That should work fine for a 30 year old but for a guy in his seventies, with a bad back, it is a daunting task.
Results.Title: Oh my aching back

Results.ReviewText: Top half of the grill is weber, solid. The cabenet lower half, not so much, flimsy, wheels are too small for outdoor use.
Results.Title: Good top, not so good bottom

Results.ReviewText: We are very pleased with our new Spirit E-210 Weber Grill. Grilled our steaks to perfection! We've had Weber grills for last 25-30 years and never been disappointed with them! I like the size (2 burner), on this one. Just right for my husband & me. We purchased this new grill from Ace Hardware that gave excellent customer service!
Results.Title: Perfect Size for Two People

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber gas grill. Impressed with how evenly it cooks. This was delivered to the house. Impressive with how easy and simple the assembly instructions are. We are enjoying this grill.
Results.Title: Impressive.

Results.ReviewText: This is the 2nd E-210 grill that I have owned. The original is over 10 years old and I am using both of them for large summer family gatherings. Granddaughter wants the old one.
Results.Title: Only Grill for Me

Results.ReviewText: I checked our other propane tank, and there is no place to hook onto the flanged gauge, just two handles, no hole in the middle.
Results.Title: Hook-up for propane tank

Results.ReviewText: Weber Warranty  - TERRIBLE!, had way more emails to verify a simple need then needed, never received the product.
Results.Title: Warranty Department Sucks!

Results.ReviewText: all in all happy with grill, replaced a 20yr old spirit 2 burner grill. gets a lot hotter than old grill, had to remove thin metal trim strip on handle, burned my finger closing cover after it had been open for awhile. a little awkward getting tank on scale. will take some time to get used to right temp to cook things but to be expected. hope to use for many years to come
Results.Title: good but some quirks

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the best one I have owned. It works well and is attractive. It has the nice feature of a scale that displays the weight of the propane tank to give an indication of the gas remaining.
Results.Title: A Very Nice Grill - Good Customer Support

Results.ReviewText: So far so good - just a couple of months. Bought it new
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane) - new

Results.ReviewText: Best grill i ever owned...glad to find out after the fact that they are American made as well. Love it
Results.Title: Best ever

Results.ReviewText: I have wanted a full-size Weber gas grill for years.  I finally took the big step and recently made my purchase.  I’m so glad I did!  Even though it’s a full-size grill, with the side tables folded down, it fits great on my small deck.  I purchased the cover for it so that I can keep it looking like new for years to come.
Results.Title: Love Love Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Not a bad grill, but they need to fully enclose the back again like it used to be.
Results.Title: Nice grill but now has a flaw

Results.ReviewText: Well built, easy to use, durable. Very impressed with the quality, is not cheaply buily. Well worth the money
Results.Title: Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: I liked it so much, I bought another 15 years later when it was finally time to replace my battered workhorse. I like the two burner versions. Never had a need for more cooking real estate, even when we were a family of four, two of whom were carnivore boys.  Now it's just my wife and I, and this is more than enough for our needs.
Results.Title: Buys Another after 15 Years

Results.ReviewText: I love my Spirit 1 grill! The grill is perfect for 1-4 people and can accommodate a half griddle insert. I love that it has two grill burners (I keep one on high and the other low or off depending) and has an upper shelf to move food off the grill but keep food warm. The grill grates are simple to remove and I wash them in my kitchen sink with Dawn and a scrubby pad. This grill starts first time, every time so far, and the controls are accurate. Great steak and smashburger searing!  Accommodates a 20 pound propane tank, and turn off is easy for the tank. This is my first propane grill and it is user friendly and easy enough for this 60 yo woman to enjoy several times a week.
Results.Title: A mighty little grill

Results.ReviewText: Little grill cooks great. Very even heat and easy to control. Plenty capacity unless you are cooking for the neighborhood. All the features including shelves work well and are well constructed. Easy to clean and use. Tank storage underneath allows both shelves to fold to a very compact size for easy storage.
Results.Title: Great little grill.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this barbecue for our trailer at the campground where we are seasonal campers. At first, I was a little hesitant downsizing to a 2 burner barbecue but we had 7 pork chops on it and I can say they were cooked to perfection. Even during assembly I couldn’t get over the quality of little things like the nuts and bolts. Never thought I’d love a barbecue as much as I do.
Results.Title: Best barbecue I’ve ever owned!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for a couple who primarily grills for 2-4 people. Love everything about it!
Results.Title: Great for a small group!

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill for my small area.  I will only purchase a Weber Grill!
Results.Title: Great grill for small area

Results.ReviewText: Very good, solid grill but best part has been the warranty.  Easy process to get replacement parts shipped to my house.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love my new Weber Grill. I haven’t had any issues so far.
Results.Title: Weber makes a great grill.

Results.ReviewText:
We NEVER had purchased this Grill - Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane) !!!  We have had numerous Weber propane grill's in the past. 
It leaks grilling sauce onto the base platform(rear) which should have gone into the Weber catch basin, which is integral to every Weber grill.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill  - No-Way Functional

Results.ReviewText: The grill works,and cooks great but there is one big issue.The hole that the bottle sits in is bigger in diameter of the standard 20 lb. propane bottles.When you try to set a standard 20 lb. bottle in,its sits on the ground.Luckily I had a 15 by 12  inch cookie sheet to sit over the hole to sit the bottle on.
Results.Title: Bottom in gas tank shelf is way too  big

Results.ReviewText: Grill door was damaged out of the box. Weber can’t get me the replacement part for three months so I had to buy the grill cover to protect the interior. Thought they would offer to send me a free cover due to the wait. Hope they haven’t forgotten me.
Results.Title: Damaged part upon opening

Results.ReviewText: I've had my Webber grill for 2 years and the grates burned through in a couple of spot.  Webber honored their warranty policy and sent new ones to replace the old ones right away.  Also, the best grill i've had for cooking.  heats up quickly and maintains an even temperature throughout..
Results.Title: Outstanding Service and Warranty

Results.ReviewText: I was tired of purchasing disposable grills every few years. Friends and family would always recommend the Weber grill. I finally took the advice and will NEVER look back. Food cooks evenly and very easy to clean. Definitely recommend the Weber.
Results.Title: Buy cheap buy twice… never looking back!!!

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
